
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/wuty/p/19306036" title="发布于 2025-12-04 11:31">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">WPF 调用 Win32的SetWindowDisplayAffinity 函数 实现捕获屏幕时，过滤指定的窗口</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>一、背景</h1>
<p>最近在开发互动传屏的需求，使用了WGC捕获桌面屏幕的方式，实现屏幕的捕获和录制。在验收阶段，产品的验收的建议是：需要过滤自身的窗口，跟腾讯会议一样，进行互动传屏。</p>
<p><strong>1、腾讯会议共享屏幕的窗口如下图</strong></p>
<p>腾讯会议的发起者的主窗口在其他设备端，是看不到的，直接透明下去。还有会议的录屏的全屏四个边角的绿框也是看不到的</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1063618/202512/1063618-20251204111120358-508738356.png" alt="image" width="1071" height="802" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><strong>2、我们自己开发的屏幕捕获的效果如下图：</strong></p>
<p>窗口在捕获之后，都是层层传递下去，类似直播的效果一样。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1063618/202512/1063618-20251204111604152-1261328395.png" alt="image" width="1120" height="610" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1>&nbsp;二、介绍SetWindowDisplayAffinity 函数&nbsp;</h1>
<p>其实微软的Win32 API 有函数 实现：<a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/windows/win32/api/winuser/nf-winuser-setwindowdisplayaffinity" rel="noopener nofollow">SetWindowDisplayAffinity 函数 (winuser.h) - Win32 apps | Microsoft Learn</a>，支持 Windows 7 中新增的窗口内容保护功能。</p>
<p>此功能使应用程序能够保护自己的屏幕窗口内容，使其免受通过一组特定的公共操作系统功能和 API 捕获或复制</p>
<div class="content">
<h1 id="setwindowdisplayaffinity-function-winuserh">SetWindowDisplayAffinity 函数 (winuser.h)</h1>
</div>
<div class="content">
<p>指定窗口内容的显示位置。</p>
<div class="heading-wrapper" data-heading-level="h2">
<h2 id="syntax" class="heading-anchor">语法</h2>
</div>
<div id="code-try-0" class="code-block-header margin-top-sm" data-code-block-header="" data-bi-name="code-header"><span class="code-block-header-language">C++</span></div>
<pre class="inner-focus" data-language="cpp"><code class="lang-cpp"><span class="hljs-function">BOOL <span class="hljs-title">SetWindowDisplayAffinity<span class="hljs-params">(
  [in] HWND  hWnd,
  [in] DWORD dwAffinity
);
</span></span></span></code></pre>
<div class="heading-wrapper" data-heading-level="h2">
<h2 id="parameters" class="heading-anchor">参数</h2>
</div>
<p><code>[in] hWnd</code></p>
<p>类型：HWND</p>
<p>顶级窗口的句柄。 窗口必须属于当前进程。</p>
<p><code>[in] dwAffinity</code></p>
<p>类型：DWORD</p>
<p>指定窗口内容的显示位置的显示相关性设置。</p>
<p>此参数的取值可为下列值之一：</p>
<div class="buttons buttons-right margin-bottom-none margin-top-sm">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="inner-focus">
<table class="table table-sm margin-top-none">
<tbody>
<tr><th>值</th><th>含义</th></tr>
<tr>
<td width="40%"><a id="WDA_NONE"></a><a id="wda_none"></a><dl><dt>WDA_NONE</dt><dt>0x00000000</dt></dl></td>
<td width="60%">对窗口的显示位置没有限制。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="40%"><a id="WDA_MONITOR"></a><a id="wda_monitor"></a><dl><dt>WDA_MONITOR</dt><dt>0x00000001</dt></dl></td>
<td width="60%">窗口内容仅显示在监视器上。 在其他任何位置，窗口都会显示，其中不显示任何内容。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="40%"><a id="WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE"></a><a id="wda_excludefromcapture"></a><dl><dt><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE</span></dt><dt>0x00000011</dt></dl></td>
<td width="60%">窗口仅显示在监视器上。 在其他任何位置，窗口根本不显示。
<p>此相关性的一个用途是用于显示视频录制控件的窗口，以便控件不包括在捕获中。</p>
<p>Windows 10版本 2004 中引入。 请参阅有关以前版本的 Windows 兼容性的备注。</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="heading-wrapper" data-heading-level="h2">
<h2 id="return-value" class="heading-anchor">返回值</h2>
</div>
<p>类型：&nbsp;BOOL</p>
<p>如果函数成功，则返回&nbsp;TRUE;例如，在非顶级窗口上进行函数调用时，它将返回&nbsp;FALSE&nbsp;。 要获得更多的错误信息，请调用 GetLastError。</p>
<div class="heading-wrapper" data-heading-level="h2">
<h2 id="remarks" class="heading-anchor">注解</h2>
</div>
<p>此函数和&nbsp;<a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/windows/desktop/api/winuser/nf-winuser-getwindowdisplayaffinity" data-linktype="absolute-path" rel="noopener nofollow">GetWindowDisplayAffinity</a>&nbsp;旨在支持 Windows 7 中新增的窗口内容保护功能。 此功能使应用程序能够保护自己的屏幕窗口内容，使其免受通过一组特定的公共操作系统功能和 API 捕获或复制。 但是，仅当桌面窗口管理器 (DWM) 组合桌面时，它才有效。</p>
<p>请务必注意，与安全功能或数字版权管理 (DRM) 实现不同，无法保证使用&nbsp;SetWindowDisplayAffinity&nbsp;和&nbsp;<a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/windows/desktop/api/winuser/nf-winuser-getwindowdisplayaffinity" data-linktype="absolute-path" rel="noopener nofollow">GetWindowDisplayAffinity</a>&nbsp;以及其他必要功能（如&nbsp;<a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/windows/desktop/api/dwmapi/nf-dwmapi-dwmiscompositionenabled" data-linktype="absolute-path" rel="noopener nofollow">DwmIsCompositionEnabled</a>）将严格保护窗口内容，例如有人拍摄屏幕照片。</p>
<p>从 Windows 10 版本 2004 开始，WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE 是受支持的值。 在以前版本的 Windows 上将显示相关性设置为WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE的行为就像应用了WDA_MONITOR一样。</p>
<div class="heading-wrapper" data-heading-level="h2">
<h2 id="requirements" class="heading-anchor">要求</h2>
</div>
<div class="buttons buttons-right margin-bottom-none margin-top-sm">&nbsp;</div>

</tr>

</tr>

</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="heading-wrapper" data-heading-level="h2">
<h2 id="see-also" class="heading-anchor">另请参阅</h2>
</div>

<h1>三、使用SetWindowDisplayAffinity 函数&nbsp;</h1>
<p><strong>1、定义&nbsp;SetWindowDisplayAffinity 函数&nbsp;</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> WDA_NONE = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00000000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> WDA_MONITOR = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00000001</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00000011</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

 [DllImport(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user32.dll</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">extern</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> SetWindowDisplayAffinity(IntPtr hWnd, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> dwAffinity);</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>2、在MainWindows 的&nbsp;SourceInitialized 事件调用（只要能获取得到窗口的句柄即可），由于我的需求是在捕获屏幕的时候，不需要显示，所以我这边调用的是：<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE（0x00000011）</span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MainWindow()
 {
     InitializeComponent();

     SourceInitialized </span>+=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MainWindow_SourceInitialized;
 }

 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IntPtr currentWindowHandle;

 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> MainWindow_SourceInitialized(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sender, EventArgs e)
 {
     currentWindowHandle </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> WindowInteropHelper(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).Handle;
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  SetWindowDisplayAffinity(currentWindowHandle, WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE);
 }

 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> WDA_NONE = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00000000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> WDA_MONITOR = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00000001</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x00000011</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

 [DllImport(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user32.dll</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">extern</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> SetWindowDisplayAffinity(IntPtr hWnd, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span> dwAffinity);</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>3、调用的效果如下：</strong></p>
<p>捕获的窗口已经没有显示主窗口了</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1063618/202512/1063618-20251204112828229-1917612363.png" alt="image" width="1008" height="697" loading="lazy"></p>
